extensionDescription.message: Saves the web page into local storage and manages saved pages in browser sidebar. Compatible with ScrapBook documents.

CUSTOM_INSTALL_TIP.message: These steps install the backend program. Save all three files in the same folder.

STEP1_TEXT_2.message: The program is downloaded from the ScrapBro release on GitHub that matches this version, and its SHA-256 checksum is verified before it is saved.

STEP2_TEXT_1.message: Download the configuration file, which tells the browser where the program is. Save it in the same folder as the program.

STEP3_TEXT_3.message: it registers the backend for your user, no administrator rights needed

STEP4_TEXT.message: Turn ScrapBro off and on again in the extensions page, or restart the browser.

BACKEND_TIP.message: ScrapBro needs its backend program to work, see the Install page and the help.

RDF_FILES_TIP.message:
An RDF file is the index of a scrapbook, the saved pages are kept in the "data" folder next to it, see help.

You can have several RDF files, also in the same folder. A file that does not exist yet is created empty.
RDF files of ScrapBook and ScrapBee work too.

Click on '+' below to add an RDF file: enter a name and the full path of the file.

OPEN_IN_CURRENT_TAB_TIP.message:
By default a click on an entry opens it in a new tab, and a click with Ctrl (Cmd on Mac) or the middle mouse button opens it in the current tab.
This option swaps the two.

DONATE_WORDS.message: ScrapBro is free. If you find it useful, you can support its development by buying me a coffee. Thank you!

NODE_MOVER_TIP.message: With this tool, you can move or copy nodes and their contents between 2 RDFs (book trees), dragging and deleting nodes within one RDF are also available here.

NODE_MOVER_WARN_TIP.message:
BE CAREFUL
Please make sure you have backup of your data before using this tool.
Do not make changes anywhere else while using this tool or it possibly causes conflicts.

ERROR_MOVE_FOLER_INTO_ITSELF.message: Invalid operation: a folder cannot be moved into itself

FAIL_START_BACKEND_HINT.message: The backend program is not running, please check the installation and the log

NO_RDF_SETTED_HINT.message: No RDF file configured yet, please check the settings

PORT_AUTO_TIP.message: Picked automatically when the backend starts, and kept as long as it stays free. Nothing to set.

STEP_SCRIPT_TEXT.message: Download the install script, which registers the configuration file with the browser. Save it in the same folder too.

INSTALL_SAME_FOLDER.message: The files are in different folders: move the program, the configuration file and the install script into one folder, then run the script there.

RESET_STATE_TIP.message: Forget where the files were saved and show all instructions again

DEBUG_TIP.message: show detailed lines in the log: backend messages, files saved, capture steps, with timings. Useful when something does not work.

DONATE_CREDIT.message: ScrapBro is based on ScrapBee by vctfence.

LOCALE_DIR.description: Name of this locale folder, do not translate.

NO_BACKEND_CHECKSUM.message: This build of ScrapBro has no checksums for the backend program, so it cannot download it. Use a release build, or get the program from the ScrapBro releases on GitHub.

BACKEND_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH.message: The downloaded program does not match its checksum and was not saved. Please try again later, or report it on GitHub.

LAUNCH_TIP.message:
Automatically: ScrapBro starts the backend program itself, nothing else to do.
Manually: ScrapBro does not start it, but connects to the address below, for a backend you run yourself (e.g. as a service, or on another computer).

PASSWORD_TIP.message:
Optional. Locks the backend so that other programs on this computer cannot use it. ScrapBro sends it by itself, you are never asked for it. Letters and digits only.
In manual mode, start the backend with the same password.

TIP_SAVE.message: Save the changes to this page

TIP_DELETE_ELEMENTS.message: Click on parts of the page to delete them, click the button again to stop

TIP_HIGHLIGHT.message: Select some text, then pick a color to highlight it

TIP_EDIT.message: Edit the text of the page directly

TIP_SOURCE_CODE.message: Edit the HTML source of the page

TIP_RELOAD.message: Reload the saved page, unsaved changes are lost

TIP_LOCATE.message: Select this page in the sidebar
